articles.title: What might Trump have planned for Iran following the midterm election?
articles.summary: While the US midterms could open a window for diplomacy with Iran, they could also unleash a new military escalation. DW spoke with analysts to identify eight factors that could tip the balance toward war or peace.

articles.title: Ice hockey officials considering options after CAS order to reinstate Russia
articles.summary: Ice hockey's ruling body is deciding how to respond to a decision by the Court of Arbitration for Sport that allows Russia back into international competition. Germany hasn't ruled out pulling out as a tournament host.

articles.title: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.summary: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.
